title: Plotting Minute-Level Activity Data
text: actiplot provides ggplot2 visualizations minute-level activity data, including steps activity counts. works standardized timestamp conventions used throughout activerse. Core entry points: acti_plot_time() complete activity time series acti_plot_day() time--day-aligned daily rows acti_plot_heatmap() date--time activity heat map

title: Plotting Minute-Level Activity Data
code: activity <- data.frame(   time = as.POSIXct("2024-01-01", tz = "UTC") + 60 * 0:1439,   steps = rpois(1440, lambda = 2) )  acti_plot_time(activity, steps, breaks = "4 hours") acti_plot_day(activity, steps, breaks = "4 hours")

what: Plot minute-level activity over time — acti_plot_time
title: Plot minute-level activity over time — acti_plot_time
text: acti_plot_time() draws time-series plot minute-level activity measure, steps activity counts. acti_plot_day() aligns data time day places date facet row. acti_plot_heatmap() provides date--time layout heat map.

title: Plot minute-level activity over time — acti_plot_time
code: acti_plot_time(data, value, time = time, breaks = NULL, ...)  acti_plot_day(data, value, time = time, breaks = "4 hours", ...)  acti_plot_heatmap(data, value, time = time, breaks = "4 hours", ...)

title: Plot minute-level activity over time — acti_plot_time
text: data data frame containing timestamp activity measure. value activity-measure column, supplied unquoted string. example, steps "counts". time timestamp column, supplied unquoted string. time default. breaks single duration "1 hour", "4 hours", "15 mins". controls x-axis spacing. Use NULL ggplot2's default full-time plot specified breaks aligned plots. ... Additional arguments passed primary geom.
